Context: Codex Keeper entry title: {0} honorific, {1} designation.

en: The Keeper of Storms turns the sky; the Founders' stones name it ATMOS. Its weather is never late, and the old ones say it comes harder when we are slow.
zh-Hans: 司雷管天气，奠基者的石刻称它为 ATMOS。它的风雨从不迟到。老人们说，我们动作一慢，它就来得更猛。
Context: Common-knowledge entry, Vigil's voice, surface only (03_Narrative R-NAR-02). Path key Storm.

en: The Keeper of the Forge, FOUNDRY on the old stones, mends whatever breaks, the Reclaimer most of all. It sends the Reclaimer back whole every time, and asks only Ichor and patience.
zh-Hans: 司炉，古代石刻上写作 FOUNDRY。东西坏了，它都会修，回收者也一样。它每次都把回收者修好送回来，只要神血，再加一点耐心。
Context: Common-knowledge entry, Vigil's voice, surface only (03_Narrative R-NAR-02). Path key Forge.

en: The Keeper of Tides, CISTERN to the Founders, keeps the water under Vigil cold and moving. Of the Six it takes the smallest tithe, and some say it is the only one that listens.
zh-Hans: 司潮，奠基者称它为 CISTERN，让守夜镇地下的水一直流动、保持冰冷。六司里它收的贡最少，有人说，只有它会听我们说话。
Context: Common-knowledge entry, Vigil's voice, surface only (03_Narrative R-NAR-02). Path key Tide.

en: The Keeper of the Dead keeps the record, LEDGER in the Founders' hand: every birth, every death, every debt. What it files is never lost, and never given back.
zh-Hans: 司幽负责记录，奠基者写作 LEDGER：每一次出生、每一次死亡、每一笔债。它记下的东西从不丢失，也从不还回来。
Context: Common-knowledge entry, Vigil's voice, surface only (03_Narrative R-NAR-02). Path key Shade.

en: The Keeper of Light, LUMEN, keeps the lamps of the Keep burning through every night. Ask it a question and it answers that question exactly, and nothing more.
zh-Hans: 司曜，也叫 LUMEN，让守境的灯每晚都亮着。你问它什么，它就只回答什么，一个字也不多说。
Context: Common-knowledge entry, Vigil's voice, surface only (03_Narrative R-NAR-02). Path key Radiance.

en: The Keeper of Ways, RELAY on the stones, carries everything that moves in the Keep: water, light, Ichor, us. It never rests, and it does not like to see anything else at rest.
zh-Hans: 司驰，石刻上写作 RELAY。守境里所有会动的东西都由它运送：水、光、神血，还有我们。它从不停下，也不喜欢看到别的东西停下。
Context: Common-knowledge entry, Vigil's voice, surface only (03_Narrative R-NAR-02). Path key Quicksilver.

en: ROOT — [no data]
zh-Hans: ROOT — [无数据]
Context: Stop-line entry after the first win: title only, no body. ROOT is a designation, the same in every culture.

en: The Reclaimer came back from the Breach carrying more than it took in. It always does, and Vigil is always glad.
zh-Hans: 回收者从裂口回来时，带回的东西比带进去的多。每次都是这样，守夜镇每次都很高兴。
Context: Recollection, Vigil's voice, opened by Discovery.ReachL10.

en: The Cast-offs come in numbers no one in Vigil has counted to the end. The Reclaimer is the only thing that goes in to meet them.
zh-Hans: 弃物多到守夜镇没人能数得完。只有回收者会走进裂口去面对它们。
Context: Recollection, Vigil's voice, opened by Discovery.ScatterKills500.

en: The Reclaimer wakes in its room with nothing in its head but its trade. Vigil keeps the room swept and asks it no questions.
zh-Hans: 回收者在自己的房间里醒来，脑子里除了干活的本事，什么都不记得。守夜镇把房间打扫得干干净净，什么也不问。
Context: Recollection, Vigil's voice, opened by Discovery.WeaponL8.

en: Every machine in the Breach was made by the Six for some work, long ago. What the work was, Vigil has forgotten; what they do now, it knows too well.
zh-Hans: 裂口里的每台机器，都是六司很久以前为某种工作造的。原来是做什么的，守夜镇早就忘了；现在它们在做什么，镇上的人再清楚不过。
Context: Recollection, Vigil's voice, opened by Discovery.Kills1000.

en: When the Breach runs cold the Cast-offs slow, and the water under Vigil goes quiet. People say the Keeper of Tides is grieving, though no one can say for what.
zh-Hans: 裂口变冷时，弃物会变慢，镇子地下的水也安静下来。人们说司潮在难过，但没人说得清为什么。
Context: Recollection, Vigil's voice, opened by Discovery.Freeze100.

en: Struck true, a Cast-off breaks open and spills Ichor as bright as lamplight. The Keeper of Light is said to watch such blows more closely than the rest.
zh-Hans: 一击打中要害，弃物就会裂开，流出像灯光一样亮的神血。听说司曜最留意这样的一击。
Context: Recollection, Vigil's voice, opened by Discovery.Crit500.

en: The Keepers speak to the Reclaimer and never to us. Those who have overheard them say the Six do not always agree.
zh-Hans: 司者只跟回收者说话，从不跟我们说。偷听过的人说，六司的想法并不总是一样。
Context: Recollection, Vigil's voice, opened by Discovery.RailKills300.

en: Tallymen keep counting even as they fall, and the Keeper of the Dead files every one. Vigil wonders whose account is being kept.
zh-Hans: 算筹倒下时仍在计数，司幽一个不落地记下。守夜镇不知道，这本账是替谁记的。
Context: Recollection, Vigil's voice, opened by Discovery.Elites10.

en: The Keeper of Storms wants the work done faster; the Keeper of Tides wants less of it done at all. A tithe that pleases one slights the other.
zh-Hans: 司雷想让活干得更快，司潮却希望少干一点。讨好了其中一个，就会得罪另一个。
Context: Recollection, Vigil's voice, opened by Discovery.TwoPaths6.

en: The old tallies say the Cast-offs come out on a schedule, never early, never late. Machines that escape do not keep time.
zh-Hans: 旧账本上写着，弃物是按时出来的，不早也不晚。真正逃出来的机器，可不会这么准时。
Context: Recollection, Vigil's voice, opened by Discovery.Survive10.

en: The strongest Cast-offs carry more Ichor than anything thrown away should. Someone keeps filling them.
zh-Hans: 最强的弃物身上的神血，多得不像被丢掉的东西。有人一直在往它们身上灌神血。
Context: Recollection, Vigil's voice, opened by Discovery.Elite3Mods.

en: The Six have another name for the Breach: the Yard. A yard is where you leave things you mean to collect.
zh-Hans: 六司给裂口起了另一个名字：清理场。清理场，就是放那些以后还要回来取走的东西的地方。
Context: Recollection, Vigil's voice, opened by Discovery.Dashes100.

en: Each run, the Six take their share of the Ichor before FOUNDRY rebuilds the Reclaimer. No one has seen that share go back into the Breach, yet the Breach never runs dry.
zh-Hans: 每一轮，六司先拿走自己那份神血，司炉才重新造出回收者。没人见过那份神血回到裂口，可裂口里的神血从来没有用完过。
Context: Recollection, Vigil's voice, opened by Discovery.DroneKills300.

en: Vigil's tithe and the Reclaimer's returns end up in the same place. The Six have never once refused either.
zh-Hans: 守夜镇交的贡，和回收者带回来的东西，最后都流到同一个地方。六司从来没有拒绝过任何一样。
Context: Recollection, Vigil's voice, opened by Discovery.Favor9.

en: When the Warden fell the Breach went quiet, and the Keepers said one word: noted. Before the next run, something was moving in the Yard again.
zh-Hans: 典狱倒下后，裂口安静了下来。司者只说了一句：已记录。可还没到下一轮，清理场里又有东西在动了。
Context: Recollection, Vigil's voice, opened by Discovery.Win.

en: Six conduits, one housing. It was built to carry all of them at once.
zh-Hans: 六道导管，共一具机身。它被造出来，就是要同时承载这六者。
Context: Warden Form III entry: first Form III kill, after three wins. States Layer 3 only. Title is Enemy.Boss.Name.

en: They arrive before the storms. Vigil's children count them to guess whether it will rain tonight.
zh-Hans: 它们总在风暴之前飞来。守夜镇的孩子数它们，猜今晚会不会下雨。
Context: [invented] Bestiary line, Vigil common knowledge, opened by the first kill of role Swarm. Title is Enemy.Swarm.Name.

en: A Bulwark is a wall that walks. Do not stand in front of one.
zh-Hans: 壁垒是一堵会走的墙。别站在它前面。
Context: [invented] Bestiary line, Vigil common knowledge, opened by the first kill of role Tank. Title is Enemy.Tank.Name.

en: A Courser only runs straight. Watch its lights.
zh-Hans: 驿骑只会直着跑。盯住它的灯。
Context: [invented] Bestiary line, Vigil common knowledge, opened by the first kill of role Rusher. Title is Enemy.Rusher.Name.

en: Flare Pylons once carried the sun into the town. Now they send something else.
zh-Hans: 耀柱曾把阳光送进镇里。现在它们送来的是别的东西。
Context: [invented] Bestiary line, Vigil common knowledge, opened by the first kill of role Turret. Title is Enemy.Turret.Name.

en: In winter they broke the ice. No one remembers why they never stopped.
zh-Hans: 它们冬天破冰。没人记得它们为什么一直没停下。
Context: [invented] Bestiary line, Vigil common knowledge, opened by the first kill of role Bruiser. Title is Enemy.Bruiser.Name.

en: When a Tallyman is near, the others move faster. Strike it first.
zh-Hans: 算筹在附近时，其他弃物动得更快。先打它。
Context: [invented] Bestiary line, Vigil common knowledge, opened by the first kill of role Support. Title is Enemy.Support.Name.

en: The largest Cast-off waits at the deep end of the Breach. Only the Reclaimer has ever come back from it.
zh-Hans: 最大的弃物守在裂口深处。只有回收者从它那里回来过。
Context: [invented] Bestiary line, Vigil common knowledge, opened by the first kill of role Boss. Title is Enemy.Boss.Name.
